title: Reach for corpus-pathfinder subagent for codebase exploration
content: For any exploration of this codebase — questions about where something is defined, what a module does, why a decision exists, who/when last changed a line, tracing a chain across files, or assessing impact of a change — dispatch the project-local `corpus-pathfinder` subagent (`.claude/agents/corpus-pathfinder.md`) instead of grepping the filesystem directly. It runs the agentic grounding loop (describe_schema → hybrid_search → inspect_entity → find_paths → bundle_evidence) against bbox's self-indexed graph and returns evidence-cited findings. Read-only by construction; never edits or mutates. Skip it for one-off code edits, single-file lookups by exact path, or when bbox MCP is unavailable.
